<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>VEXQO — Páginas web y marketing para tu negocio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#241012;
    --panel:#331619;
    --panel-2:#3D1B1E;
    --cream:#FAF3E7;
    --cream-dim:#EBE0CB;
    --ink:#241512;
    --copper:#B23B36;
    --amber:#D42A2E;
    --teal:#9C4B3D;
    --danger:#B23128;
    --line-dark: rgba(250,243,231,0.14);
    --line-light: rgba(36,21,18,0.14);
    --radius: 4px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation-duration:0.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:0.001ms !important;}
  }
  body{
    background:var(--cream);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Inter', sans-serif;
    line-height:1.55;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }
  .mono{ font-family:'Space Mono', monospace; letter-spacing:0.01em; }
  a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
  .wrap{ max-width:1160px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px; }
  ::selection{ background:var(--amber); color:var(--cream); }
  a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, textarea:focus-visible{
    outline:2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset:3px;
  }

  /* ---------- LED status dot, used as recurring device ---------- */
  .led{
    width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--amber); flex-shrink:0;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(227,168,59,0.18);
    animation:pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse{ 0%,100%{opacity:1;} 50%{opacity:0.45;} }

  /* ---------- NAV ---------- */
  header{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(237,231,216,0.94); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light);
  }
  nav.wrap{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; height:76px; }
  .logo{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:1.65rem; letter-spacing:-0.01em; }
  .logo svg{ width:28px; height:28px; flex-shrink:0; }
  .logo img{ width:34px; height:34px; }
  .nav-links{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:34px; list-style:none; font-size:0.9rem; }
  .nav-links a{ position:relative; padding:6px 0; }
  .nav-links a::after{ content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; width:0; height:1.5px; background:var(--copper); transition:width .25s ease; }
  .nav-links a:hover::after, .nav-links a:focus-visible::after{ width:100%; }
  .nav-status{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--teal); }
  .nav-toggle{ display:none; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; width:36px; height:28px; position:relative; }
  .nav-toggle span, .nav-toggle span::before, .nav-toggle span::after{
    content:''; position:absolute; left:0; width:100%; height:2px; background:var(--ink);
    transition:transform .2s ease, opacity .2s ease;
  }
  .nav-toggle span{ top:13px; } .nav-toggle span::before{ top:-9px; } .nav-toggle span::after{ top:9px; }
  .nav-toggle.open span{ background:transparent; }
  .nav-toggle.open span::before{ transform:translateY(9px) rotate(45deg); }
  .nav-toggle.open span::after{ transform:translateY(-9px) rotate(-45deg); }
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .nav-status{ display:none; }
    .nav-links{
      position:fixed; inset:76px 0 auto 0; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:0;
      background:var(--cream); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-light);
      max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .3s ease;
    }
    .nav-links.open{ max-height:320px; }
    .nav-links li{ width:100%; border-top:1px solid var(--line-light); }
    .nav-links a{ display:block; padding:16px 32px; }
    .nav-toggle{ display:block; }
  }

  /* ---------- HERO ---------- */
  .hero{ position:relative; background:var(--bg); color:var(--cream); padding:114px 0 120px; overflow:hidden; }
  .circuit{
    position:absolute; right:-60px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%);
    width:620px; max-width:70vw; opacity:0.9; pointer-events:none;
  }
  .circuit path{ fill:none; stroke:var(--teal); stroke-opacity:0.5; stroke-width:1.6; }
  .circuit .active{
    stroke:var(--amber); stroke-opacity:0.95; stroke-width:2;
    stroke-dasharray:900; stroke-dashoffset:900; animation:trace 2.6s ease forwards 0.3s;
  }
  @keyframes trace{ to{ stroke-dashoffset:0; } }
  .circuit .pad{ fill:var(--panel-2); stroke:var(--teal); stroke-width:1.2; }
  .circuit .pad.on{ fill:var(--amber); opacity:0; animation:blink .4s ease forwards; }
  .circuit .pad.on:nth-of-type(1){ animation-delay:0.6s; }
  .circuit .pad.on:nth-of-type(2){ animation-delay:1.3s; }
  .circuit .pad.on:nth-of-type(3){ animation-delay:2s; }
  .circuit .pad.on:nth-of-type(4){ animation-delay:2.6s; }
  @keyframes blink{ to{ opacity:1; } }

  .hero-grid{ position:relative; z-index:2; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.05fr 0.95fr; gap:48px; align-items:center; }
  .hero-inner{ max-width:620px; }
  .hero-media img{ width:100%; display:block; border-radius:10px; box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45); border:1px solid var(--line-dark); }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .hero-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:'Space Mono', monospace; font-size:0.76rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.12em;
    color:var(--amber); margin-bottom:22px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{ content:''; width:22px; height:1px; background:var(--amber); }
  .hero h1{ font-size:clamp(2.5rem, 5.2vw, 4.1rem); line-height:1.06; margin-bottom:24px; }
  .hero p.lead{ font-size:1.1rem; color:var(--cream-dim); max-width:480px; margin-bottom:36px; }
  .btn-row{ display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:15px 26px; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:500;
    border-radius:var(--radius); cursor:pointer; border:1px solid transparent; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    transition:transform .18s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover{ transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .btn-primary{ background:var(--amber); color:var(--cream); }
  .btn-primary:hover{ background:#EB4448; }
  .btn-ghost-dark{ border-color:var(--cream-dim); color:var(--cream); }
  .btn-ghost-dark:hover{ background:var(--cream); color:var(--ink); }
  .btn-ghost-light{ border-color:var(--ink); color:var(--ink); }
  .btn-ghost-light:hover{ background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream); }

  .stat-row{ margin-top:54px; display:flex; gap:40px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .stat-row div strong{ font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:1.9rem; color:var(--amber); display:block; }
  .stat-row div span{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.72rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:var(--cream-dim); }

  /* ---------- SECTION shared ---------- */
  section{ padding:104px 0; position:relative; }
  .section-head{ max-width:560px; margin-bottom:60px; }
  .section-head .eyebrow{ margin-bottom:16px; }
  .section-head h2{ font-size:clamp(1.9rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem); }
  .section-head p{ opacity:0.78; margin-top:16px; font-size:1.02rem; }
  .band-dark{ background:var(--bg); color:var(--cream); }
  .band-dark .eyebrow{ color:var(--amber); }
  .band-dark .section-head p{ color:var(--cream-dim); opacity:1; }

  .reveal{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(22px); transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
  .reveal.in{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }

  /* ---------- FUNDAMENTOS ---------- */
  .pillars{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:1px; background:var(--line-dark); border:1px solid var(--line-dark); }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .pillars{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); } }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .pillars{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .pillar{ background:var(--panel); padding:38px 28px; min-height:250px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }
  .pillar svg{ width:32px; height:32px; stroke:var(--amber); }
  .pillar h3{ font-size:1.1rem; color:var(--cream); }
  .pillar p{ font-size:0.92rem; color:var(--cream-dim); }
  .pillar .tag{ margin-top:auto; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--teal); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; }

  /* ---------- QUIENES SOMOS ---------- */
  .about-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.95fr 1.05fr; gap:66px; align-items:center; }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .about-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:44px; } }
  .readout{
    position:relative; aspect-ratio:4/5; border-radius:var(--radius); background:var(--ink); color:var(--cream);
    padding:26px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid rgba(237,231,216,0.1);
  }
  .readout::before{
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
    background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(237,231,216,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(237,231,216,0.045) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size:24px 24px;
  }
  .readout-head{ position:relative; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.68rem; color:var(--teal); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; }
  .readout-wave{ position:relative; }
  .readout-wave polyline{ fill:none; stroke:var(--amber); stroke-width:2; }
  .readout-foot{ position:relative; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--cream-dim); border-top:1px solid rgba(237,231,216,0.14); padding-top:14px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; }
  .about-copy p{ margin-bottom:18px; opacity:0.88; }
  .about-copy p:first-of-type{ font-size:1.06rem; }
  .team{ margin-top:36px; display:flex; gap:24px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .team-member{ display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:center; min-width:190px; }
  .avatar{
    width:50px; height:50px; border-radius:6px; flex-shrink:0;
    background:linear-gradient(140deg, var(--teal), var(--copper));
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--cream);
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700;
  }
  .team-member .name{ font-size:0.92rem; font-weight:600; }
  .team-member .role{ font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--teal); font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; }

  .vexqo-quote{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink);
    border-left:3px solid var(--amber); padding:4px 0 4px 20px; margin:26px 0;
  }
  .vexqo-letters{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; margin:26px 0; }
  .vexqo-letters div{ display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:flex-start; }
  .vexqo-letters strong{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:1.5rem; color:var(--amber);
    width:34px; flex-shrink:0; line-height:1;
  }
  .vexqo-letters span{ font-size:0.92rem; opacity:0.85; padding-top:3px; }
  .vexqo-mission{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.98rem; color:var(--teal);
    padding:16px 18px; background:rgba(60,135,112,0.08); border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:18px;
  }

  /* ---------- TARJETA / QR ---------- */
  .card-band{ background:var(--panel); color:var(--cream); }
  .card-band .eyebrow{ color:var(--amber); }
  .card-band .section-head p{ color:var(--cream-dim); }
  .card-wrap{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr;
    background:var(--bg); border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden; box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
  }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .card-wrap{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .card-info{ padding:50px 46px; }
  .card-info .role{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.74rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.1em; color:var(--amber); margin-bottom:10px; }
  .card-info h3{ font-size:1.9rem; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .card-info .org{ color:var(--cream-dim); margin-bottom:26px; font-size:0.94rem; }
  .card-details{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; margin-bottom:30px; }
  .card-details div{ display:flex; gap:12px; font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--cream-dim); }
  .card-details .mono{ color:var(--cream); }
  .social-row{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .social-btn{
    width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(237,231,216,0.25);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    transition:background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .social-btn svg{ width:18px; height:18px; stroke:var(--cream); }
  .social-btn:hover{ background:var(--amber); border-color:var(--amber); transform:translateY(-3px); }
  .social-btn:hover svg{ stroke:var(--ink); }
  .card-qr{ background:var(--cream); display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:42px; gap:16px; }
  .qr-frame{ padding:10px; background:#fff; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--line-light); max-width:100%; }
  .qr-frame img{ width:320px; max-width:100%; height:auto; display:block; border-radius:3px; }
  .card-qr .hint{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.74rem; text-align:center; color:var(--ink); opacity:0.7; max-width:260px; }

  /* ---------- Proyectos ---------- */
  .card-band-prg{ background-color:var(--bg); color:var(--cream); }
  .card-band-prg .eyebrow{ color:var(--amber); }
  .card-band-prg .section-head p{ color:var(--cream-dim); }
  .projects-grid{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:24px; }
  .project-card{
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line-dark); border-radius:8px;
    padding:34px 30px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 260px; gap:28px; align-items:center;
  }
  @media (max-width:800px){ .project-card{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .project-body{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }
  .project-icon{ width:34px; height:34px; stroke:var(--amber); flex-shrink:0; }
  .project-card h3{ color:var(--cream); font-size:1.2rem; margin-top:2px; }
  .project-sub{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.74rem; color:var(--teal); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; }
  .project-block .project-label{ display:block; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:var(--copper); margin-bottom:6px; }
  .project-block p{ font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--cream-dim); }
  .tech-tags{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-top:4px; }
  .tech-tags span{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--cream);
    background:rgba(250,243,231,0.08); border:1px solid var(--line-dark);
    padding:5px 10px; border-radius:20px;
  }
  .project-media{ width:100%; height:220px; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line-dark); }
  .project-media img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  @media (max-width:800px){ .project-media{ height:200px; order:2; } }


  /* ---------- COMBOS / PLANES ---------- */
  .pricing-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:24px; align-items:stretch; }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .pricing-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .price-card{
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line-dark); border-radius:8px;
    padding:38px 32px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:22px; position:relative;
  }
  .price-card.featured{
    background:var(--panel-2); border-color:var(--amber);
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    transform:translateY(-8px);
  }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .price-card.featured{ transform:none; } }
  .price-badge{
    position:absolute; top:-13px; right:28px; background:var(--amber); color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em;
    padding:5px 12px; border-radius:20px; font-weight:700;
  }
  .price-card h3{ color:var(--cream); font-size:1.3rem; }
  .price-card .price-sub{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--teal); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; }
  .price-main{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .price-main .amount{ font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:2.1rem; color:var(--amber); font-weight:700; }
  .price-main .period{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--cream-dim); }
  .price-maint{
    font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--cream-dim);
    border-top:1px dashed rgba(237,231,216,0.22); border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(237,231,216,0.22);
    padding:12px 0; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .price-maint .led{ margin-top:4px; }
  .price-features{ list-style:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; font-size:0.92rem; color:var(--cream-dim); flex-grow:1; }
  .price-features li{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; }
  .price-features li svg{ width:16px; height:16px; stroke:var(--amber); flex-shrink:0; margin-top:3px; }
  .price-note{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.72rem; color:var(--cream-dim); opacity:0.7; text-align:center; margin-top:22px; }

  /* ---------- CONTACTO ---------- */
  .contact-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.9fr 1.1fr; gap:66px; }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .contact-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:48px; } }
  .contact-list{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:24px; }
  .contact-item{ border-top:1px solid var(--line-light); padding-top:18px; }
  .contact-item .label{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.7rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:var(--teal); margin-bottom:6px; }
  .contact-item .value{ font-size:1.05rem; }
  form{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:20px; }
  .field{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }
  .field label{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.72rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:var(--teal); }
  .field select, .field input, .field textarea{
    background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--line-light);
    padding:10px 2px; font-family:'Inter', sans-serif; font-size:1rem; color:var(--ink);
    transition:border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .field select:focus, .field input:focus, .field textarea:focus{ border-color:var(--amber); outline:none; }
  .field textarea{ resize:vertical; min-height:96px; }
  .form-note{ font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.76rem; opacity:0.6; }

  /* ---------- FOOTER ---------- */
  footer{ background:var(--bg); color:var(--cream-dim); padding:54px 0 32px; }
  .footer-top{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:28px;
    padding-bottom:32px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(237,231,216,0.14); margin-bottom:24px;
  }
  .footer-logo{ font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; color:var(--cream); font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; }
  .footer-bottom{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; font-family:'Space Mono',monospace; font-size:0.74rem; }
  .footer-note{ opacity:0.55; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <nav class="wrap">
    <a href="#inicio" class="logo">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo VEXQO" style="width:34px;height:34px;object-fit:contain;flex-shrink:0;">
      Vexqo>
    </a>
    <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
      <li><a href="#fundamentos">Fundamentos</a></li>
      <li><a href="#quienes-somos">Quiénes somos</a></li>
      <li><a href="#tarjeta">Tarjeta</a></li>
      <li><a href="#combos">Planes</a></li>
      <li><a href="#contacto">Contacto</a></li>
    </ul>
    <div class="nav-status"><span class="led"></span>AGENCIA ABIERTA</div>
    <button class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" aria-label="Abrir menú" aria-expanded="false"><span></span></button>
  </nav>
</header>

<!-- ================= HERO ================= -->
<section class="hero" id="inicio">
  <svg class="circuit" viewBox="0 0 600 500" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="M40 250 H180 V120 H340" />
    <path d="M40 250 V380 H260 V440" />
    <path d="M340 120 V60 H520" />
    <path d="M260 380 H420 V300 H560" />
    <path class="active" d="M40 250 H180 V120 H340 V60 H520" />
    <circle class="pad" cx="40" cy="250" r="6"/>
    <circle class="pad on" cx="180" cy="120" r="6"/>

<!-- ================= QUIENES SOMOS ================= -->
<section id="quienes-somos">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="section-head reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">Nuestra historia</div>
      <h2>Más allá de la puerta</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="about-grid">
      <div class="readout reveal">
        <div class="readout-head"><span>VEXQO</span><span class="mono" style="color:var(--amber);">EN MOVIMIENTO</span></div>
        <svg class="readout-wave" viewBox="0 0 260 90" width="100%" height="90">
          <polyline points="0,45 30,45 40,10 55,80 70,20 85,60 100,45 260,45"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="readout-foot"><span>NEGOCIO × CLIENTE</span><span>MUNDO</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="about-copy reveal">
        <p>VEXQO comenzó con una observación. Los cinco fundadores —Tadeo, Santi, Lautaro, Aylen y Victoria— veían algo que se repetía en casi todos los negocios con los que trabajaban: había negocios increíbles que solamente podían venderle a las personas que entraban por su puerta.</p>
        <p>Un buen producto podía quedar escondido en un pequeño local. Una marca podía tener algo increíble para ofrecer, pero nadie fuera de su ciudad sabía que existía.</p>
        <div class="vexqo-quote">¿Y si pudiéramos sacar esa puerta del negocio?</div>
        <p>Internet ya había hecho posible llegar a cualquier lugar. Pero faltaba algo: hacer que cada negocio pudiera aprovechar realmente esa posibilidad. Querían crear algo que fuera más que una página web. Querían construir un puente entre un negocio y cualquier persona del mundo.</p>
        <p>Durante días buscaron un nombre que representara esa idea. Hasta que apareció VEXQO. No era una palabra existente. Y justamente por eso les gustó: porque VEXQO no representaba un lugar, un producto ni una tecnología específica. Representaba movimiento.</p>
        <div class="vexqo-letters">
          <div><strong>V</strong><span>El comienzo: ver una oportunidad.</span></div>
          <div><strong>X</strong><span>El encuentro: negocio × cliente.</span></div>
          <div><strong>Q</strong><span>Convertida en un círculo, representa el mundo — y la pequeña línea que sale de ella es una flecha: salir de donde estás y llegar más lejos.</span></div>
        </div>
        <p>Así nació la identidad de VEXQO. Desde entonces, cada proyecto tiene la misma misión:</p>
        <p class="vexqo-mission">Tomar lo que un negocio hace bien y llevarlo mucho más lejos.</p>
        <p>Porque para VEXQO, una tienda online no es simplemente una página. Es una puerta abierta al mundo.</p>
        <div class="team">
          <div class="team-member">
            <div class="avatar">SB</div>
            <div><div class="name">Santiago Benites</div><div class="role">Jefe de programación</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="team-member">
            <div class="avatar">TL</div>
            <div><div class="name">Tucci Lautaro</div><div class="role">Fundador o CEO</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="team-member">

          </div>

<script>
  const toggle = document.getElementById('navToggle');
  const links = document.getElementById('navLinks');
  toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const open = links.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.classList.toggle('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open);
  });
  links.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
    links.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', false);
  }));

  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('in'); });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el => io.observe(el));
</script>

</body>
</html>
